data.description:
## Knowledge Needed
- Read: docs/design-git-training-data-structures.md (Quality signals section)
- Understand: bit manipulation in Python
- Review: commit quality signal detection patterns

## Implementation
Create in cortical/spark/quality_signals.py:
1. QualitySignals class with bit constants
2. SHA → index mapping for O(1) lookup
3. set_signal(sha, SIGNAL) and get_multiplier(sha)
4. Weight multipliers per signal type

## Guardrails
- DO: Use power-of-2 bit constants for clarity
- DO: Handle unknown SHAs gracefully (return 1.0 multiplier)
- DO: Pre-allocate for expected capacity
- DO NOT: Store strings - only indices and bytes
- DO NOT: Make this public API yet (internal optimization)
- EXPLORE: Whether to detect signals lazily or eagerly
- EXPLORE: Combining with temporal decay in same structure

## Success Criteria
- 80%+ memory savings vs Dict[str, Dict[str, bool]]
- All 8 signal types supported
- Reverted signal correctly returns 0.0 multiplier
- Thread-safe for future parallel processing
data.title: Implement QualitySignals bit-packed storage
